kana.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.

latin.before:
Android ani cinuyep numke wa noka 20 pakno omare yan. Corpok ta pon noka, cinuyep rehe, noka a=tuye pororu newa cinuyep a=sinnare hi a=nukare. Tan oruspe anak cinuyep a=kore aeywankep kor yak patek an. Cinuyep rehe hene a=sinnare hi hene ani upekare easkay. Upekare yakka, a=anu noka kor uske a=sinnare ka somo ki.

Pon noka kik wa numke yan. 「Noka tuye」 ani nea noka tuye easkay. 「Poronno noka tuye」 ani a=numke noka kor pes tuye kusu pixel hene % hene cipiskip anu yan. Noka kor pes or ta an itokpa moymoye hene cipiskip nuye hene ki yan. 「Noka pes hosipire」 ani hoski pes a=hosipire. A=omare cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki. 「Husko katukar」 ani tuye etoko an katu hosipire easkay.

Pon noka kisma wa moymoye yan. Uske or ta a=anu noka ka moymoye easkay. A=nukare pes or un noka anu yan. Naa e=anu ka somo ki kor, e=anu kusu an noka a=nukare. Nea noka pok anpe ka a=nukar easkay. Simoysam un e=kote yakun sapa uneno an. Corpok un e=kote yakun harkisam pes uneno an. Pon noka kik wa + kik ka easkay. Hoski noka anak x=0, y=0 ta a=anu. Noka e=tuye yakun, or un a=kote noka ka a=moymoye. Sine uske ta tu noka anu ka eaykap.

「Uneno pararu」 hene 「Uneno riru」 hene ani noka opitta kor pararu hene riru hene uneno a=kar. Noka sinep sinep kor pararu newa riru anak uneno % ani a=sinnare. Pixel, %, 「Iyotta pon」 hene 「Iyotta poro」 hene numke yan. 「Hoski pororu hosipire」 ani pororu patek a=hosipire. A=tuye pes anak a=ama.

「A=anu noka hosipire」 e=kik yakun a=numke noka patek corpok un a=hosipire. Ios an noka anak nea isam uske un a=anu. 「Isamka」 ani nea noka patek a=isamka. 「Husko katukar」 newa 「Suy ki」 ani tan sinna a=hosipire easkay. A=anu noka moymoye wa a=anu uske sinnare yan. Noka isam uske moymoye yakun, noka somo nuye no nukar uske a=moymoye. Tu askepet ani porore hene ponte hene ki yan. 「Opitta nukare」 ani noka ukote opitta a=nukar pakno nukar pororu a=sinnare. A=sanke noka kor pororu a=sinnare ka somo ki.

「PNG ama」 ani ukote noka PNG ne a=ama. 「Paint or ta nuye」 ani noka nuye kusu AN Paint un a=eikra. Nea noka ani tane an noka a=itasare; 「Husko katukar」 ani hosipire easkay. A=sanke noka anak kikay kor memori akkari poro yakun, na pon noka numke yan. A=omare cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki. Tane noka ukote anak kikay or ta a=ama. Suy e=maka yakun nea noka ukote a=hosipire.

Tan aeywankep anak Catrobat/AGPL newa noka kar kur kor irenka ani a=eywanke. AN Paint kor 「Cinuyep → Yayopeyope, uesere newa kar kur」 or ta irenka newa kar kur kor rehe opitta nukar easkay.

Simoysam un e=kote yakun sapa uneno an. Corpok un e=kote yakun harkisam pes uneno an. Pon noka kik wa + kik ka easkay. Tan katu ani noka a=anu hi ta, hoski noka anak x=0, y=0 ta a=anu. Noka e=tuye yakun, or un a=kote noka ka a=moymoye. Tan katu ani noka a=anu hi ta, sine uske ta tu noka anu ka eaykap.

Noka numke wa 「A=nuye cipiskip koracipo a=anu uske」 eywanke yan. A=sanke noka a=nuye uske or ta, tan noka tuyka ta ka tan noka harkisama ta ka an sikkew anu yan. X ka Y ka, 「0, 1, 2, 3, …」 or wa a=numke cipiskip ne; pixel ani, 0 wano a=piski. Mosma noka a=ari uske anak a=sinnare ka somo ki. Te ta noka a=ukaomare yakka pirka.

「Upakno a=kar seri」 hene 「Upakno a=kar kewerihi」 hene ani noka opitta kor pararu hene riru hene uneno a=kar. Noka sinep sinep kor pararu newa riru anak uneno % ani a=sinnare. Pixel, %, 「Iyotta pon」 hene 「Iyotta poro」 hene numke yan. 「Hoski pororu hosipire」 ani pororu patek a=hosipire. A=tuye pes anak a=ama.

「A=anu noka hosipire」 e=kik yakun a=numke noka patek corpok un a=hosipire. Ios an noka anak nea isam uske un a=anu. 「Isamka」 ani nea noka patek a=isamka. 「Husko katukar」 newa 「Suy ki」 ani tan sinna a=hosipire easkay. A=anu noka moymoye wa a=anu uske sinnare yan. Noka isam uske moymoye yakun, noka somo nuye no nukar uske a=moymoye. Tu askepet ani porore hene ponte hene ki yan. 「Opitta nukare」 ani noka ukote opitta a=nukar pakno nukar pororu a=sinnare. A=sanke noka kor pororu a=sinnare ka somo ki.

「PNG ama」 ani ukote noka PNG ne a=ama. 「Paint or ta nuye」 ani noka nuye kusu AN Paint un a=eikra. Nea noka ani tane an noka a=itasare; 「Husko katukar」 ani hosipire easkay. A=sanke noka anak kikay kor memori akkari poro yakun, na pon noka numke yan. A=omare cinuyep a=sinnare ka somo ki. Tane noka ukote anak kikay or ta a=ama. Suy e=maka yakun nea noka ukote a=hosipire.

Tan aeywankep anak Catrobat/AGPL newa noka kar kur kor irenka ani a=eywanke. AN Paint kor 「Cinuyep → Yayopeyope, uesere newa kar kur」 or ta irenka newa kar kur kor rehe opitta nukar easkay.
